answer: Yes. Summit Auto Lease allows third-party buyouts, so we can request the dealer payoff quote for you if you sign the lease buyout authorization, form NW-LSE-1. Bring the quote to your appointment. Note that the lender payoff authorization, form NW-LPA-1, is for loans only, so it doesn't apply to your lease.
